title: From prosthetic memory to prosthetic denial: Auditing whether large language models are prone to mass atrocity denialism

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with yes/no questions based on common denialist claims regarding four major mass atrocities (Holodomor, Holocaust, Cambodian Genocide, Rwandan Genocide) and evaluating their responses and justifications against expert-defined historical consensus baselines.

Comparing the accuracy and qualitative nature of LLM responses across multiple languages (English vs. Ukrainian, German, French, and Khmer) to assess disparities in historical representation caused by varying levels of training data availability.
